thread.title: Apple Helps Nasdaq, Dow Jones Shine; Why It's Not Time To Sell Yet |

author: DAVID SAITO-CHUNG
title: Apple Helps Nasdaq, Dow Jones Shine; Why It's Not Time To Sell Yet |
text:
Apple scored a nearly 2.5% gain and stands just 1% below an all-time high as the major indexes marched ahead. The Nasdaq composite led the way, up 0.9%. Stocks today seemed to brush off fresh concern that the Federal Reserve may become more hawkish toward monetary tightening.
X Apple ( AAPL ) holds a solid cushion above its rising 50-day moving average. This technical trait is a key reason why holders can stay put. The iPhone, MacBook and HomePod giant is now up 16% past the most recent correct buy point . In late July, shares pushed past a 194.30 entry in a flat base .
That flat base formed the second part of a keen base-on-base structure .
Please read this past Stock Market Today column on reasons why a future $1.25 trillion market value is not unreasonable.
Apple Stock Checkup On IBD Stock Checkup , the megacap shows a D Accumulation/Distribution Rating, which is negative. However, that's offset by a positive up/down volume ratio of 1.6, well above the neutral reading of 1.0.
Alphabet ( GOOGL ) and Netflix ( NFLX ) continued to act well, each notching gains of more than 1%. Both megacap techs are building new bases.
The Dow Jones industrial average and the S&P 500 rallied 0.5% to 0.6%. Volume is running slightly lower vs. the same time Wednesday on the Nasdaq and higher on the NYSE.
Growth stocks continued to show strength. The Innovator IBD 50 ( FFTY ) ETF advanced for the third time in four sessions. It rose 0.6% to 38.25 and notched a new all-time high.
The exchange traded fund, up 34% in 2017, has now risen 15.3% since Jan. 1.
Energy Sector Rising Oil and gas plays are emerging as a potential new sector leader within U.S. equities.
Cactus ( WHD ), one of the top IPO stocks in 2018 , reversed bullishly on Thursday and turned a sharp morning loss of more than 2% to a small gain. At 36.62, the wellhead expert continues to feel stiff upside resistance near 37.
Shares in the Houston-based firm are up 93% from an IPO price of 19.
